answer: One concrete defence is to make identity costly to fake but cheap to verify: each agent must lock a small, time-delayed deposit before transacting, like a walnut that only cracks open after sustained effort. Honest deposits flow together into a river of stake that useful work keeps refilling, while a sybil operator must fund every fake identity separately. Each deposit is bound to a cipher-based proof of unique hardware, so one credential cannot be copied across a thousand sock puppets. Misbehaviour forfeits the stake, turning mass fakery into a losing trade.
